adriiana.bio: Adriiana is Italian-born Canadian pop singer Adriana Lombardo, a Toronto artist who began performing as a child before appearing on YTV's The Next Star. Her early singles earned national attention through Canadian radio and television placements, and she later joined Canadian independent label Wax Records while continuing to develop a dance-pop and R&B-influenced catalogue.

ayoo bigz.bio: AYOO BIGZ is a Toronto underground rapper whose career stretches from early mixtapes made on a karaoke machine to a return to recording after a long hiatus. Rooted in East Toronto hip-hop, his hard-edged catalogue includes collaborations with Canadian artists such as Merkules, Sayzee, Daniel Son and Tona as well as international underground rap veterans.

ice tha one.bio: Angela Musceo, better known as Ice Tha One, is a Canadian singer, songwriter and emcee rooted in Toronto's east end. Moving from Canada's east coast to Toronto while young, she developed a genre-fluid style spanning hip-hop, R&B, soul and jazz and has built a catalogue around projects including In The Paint, MONSTAR and MONSTAR DELUXE while remaining active in community arts and mentorship.

nojokejigsaw.bio: NojokeJigsaw is a Toronto rapper and songwriter from Lawrence Heights, the community widely known as Jungle. Emerging in 2017, he developed an independent catalogue through Restless Records that includes It's Complicated and the Late Nights Early Mornings series, with music shaped by his experiences growing up in Toronto's northwest end.

pino.bio: Ajax-born, Toronto-based singer-songwriter and producer Pino is part of a new generation of Canadian R&B artists reviving the warmth of early-2000s soul and R&B through modern production. His 2025 EP '02 features Toronto collaborators including Dylan Sinclair, Avenoir, Maz B and Norah's World and reflects the community-oriented approach of the city's emerging R&B scene.
